@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+"""Small CLI-based SQL scenario runner for authored, source-grounded regression cases.
+
+The database process is supplied by the case environment. Credentials and endpoints
+are configurable through ACREPAIR_* environment variables. This runner does not
+start a database server and its presence is not proof that an adapter is ready.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path as _AC_Path
+_AC_CHECKS_DIR = _AC_Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+
+def _cmd(scenario, query, role):
+    driver = scenario['driver']
+    sql = query['sql']
+    if driver == 'clickhouse':
+        if role == 'root': role = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER', 'default')
+        return ['clickhouse-client', '--format', 'TabSeparatedRaw', '--user', role, '--query', sql]
+    if driver in ('mysql', 'mariadb', 'tidb', 'starrocks'):
+        if role == 'root': role = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER', 'root')
+        binary = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_MYSQL_CLIENT', 'mariadb')
+        argv = [binary, '--batch', '--skip-column-names', '--user', role]
+        password = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_' + role.upper())
+        if password is None: password = scenario.get('credentials', {}).get(role)
+        if password is not None:
+            argv.append('--password=' + password)
+        host = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_HOST', '')
+        port = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_PORT', '')
+        socket = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_SOCKET', '')
+        if host: argv += ['--host', host]
+        if port: argv += ['--port', port]
+        if socket: argv += ['--socket', socket]
+        database = query.get('database')
+        if database: argv += ['--database', database]
+        argv += ['--execute', sql]
+        return argv
+    if driver == 'firebird':
+        if role == 'root': role = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER', 'SYSDBA')
+        binary = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_ISQL', 'isql')
+        dsn = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN')
+        if not dsn: raise RuntimeError('ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN is required')
+        password = os.environ.get('ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_' + role.upper())
+        if password is None: password = scenario.get('credentials', {}).get(role, 'masterkey')
+        argv = [binary, '-user', role, '-password', password]
+        active_role = query.get('active_role')
+        if active_role:
+            argv += ['-role', active_role]
+        return argv + [dsn]
+    raise RuntimeError('No SQL CLI for driver: ' + driver)
+
+
+def _run(scenario, query, role):
+    argv = _cmd(scenario, query, role)
+    payload = ('SET BAIL ON;\n' + query['sql'] + '\n') if scenario['driver'] == 'firebird' else None
+    timeout = int(scenario.get('query_timeout_seconds', 60))
+    try:
+        p = subprocess.run(argv, input=payload, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
+        return {'role': role, 'sql': query['sql'], 'returncode': p.returncode,
+                'stdout': p.stdout, 'stderr': p.stderr, 'command': argv}
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        return {'role': role, 'sql': query['sql'], 'returncode': 124,
+                'stdout': exc.stdout or '', 'stderr': 'SQL_TIMEOUT', 'command': argv,
+                'infrastructure_error': 'SQL_TIMEOUT'}
+
+
+def _matches(actual, expected):
+    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or not expected: return False
+    if 'success' in expected and ((actual['returncode'] == 0) != expected['success']): return False
+    if 'returncode' in expected and actual['returncode'] != expected['returncode']: return False
+    if 'stdout_contains' in expected and expected['stdout_contains'] not in actual['stdout']: return False
+    if 'stdout_not_contains' in expected and expected['stdout_not_contains'] in actual['stdout']: return False
+    if 'stdout_empty' in expected and (not isinstance(expected['stdout_empty'], bool) or (not actual['stdout'].strip()) != expected['stdout_empty']): return False
+    if 'stderr_contains' in expected and expected['stderr_contains'] not in actual['stderr'] + actual['stdout']: return False
+    return True
+
+
+def main():
+    scenario = json.loads(Path(str(_AC_CHECKS_DIR / 'scenario.json')).read_text())
+    checks=[]; targets=[]; transcript=[]
+    for step in scenario['steps']:
+        actual=[]
+        for query in step['queries']:
+            result=_run(scenario,query,query.get('role',step.get('role','root')))
+            transcript.append(result); actual.append(result)
+            if result.get('infrastructure_error'):
+                print('CHECK_RESULT='+json.dumps({
+                    'harness_error': result['infrastructure_error'],
+                    'origin': scenario['origin'],
+                    'transcript': transcript,
+                },ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
+                return
+        good=all(_matches(a,q['expect']) for a,q in zip(actual,step['queries']))
+        if step['kind']=='setup':
+            if not good: raise RuntimeError('SQL_SETUP_FAILED: '+json.dumps(actual,ensure_ascii=False))
+            continue
+        checks.append({'name':step['name'],'kind':step['kind'],'passed':good,
+                       'actual':actual,'expected':[q['expect'] for q in step['queries']]})
+        if step['kind']=='target':
+            targets.append(not good and all(_matches(a,q['bug']) for a,q in zip(actual,step['queries'])))
+    controls=all(x['passed'] for x in checks if x['kind']=='control')
+    print('CHECK_RESULT='+json.dumps({'checks':checks,'reproduced':bool(targets) and all(targets) and controls,
+          'origin':scenario['origin'],'transcript':transcript},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__': main()

+TEST_STATUS = 'authored_unexecuted'
+EXPECTED_FILES = {'case_body.py': 'b2d736fc76c17ee915861b10248e029c6baa5a093ae5208703dd74aae4fbdd23', 'record.json': 'a4da683a6dbec4685227859f377c73bbcba9e2973bf8b6bd72e9943687f07fc8', 'scenario.json': '3589049d070c095d0637f4ecd762a24dddeae3eee668759eb46024a7b6d3a851', 'scenario.sql': 'c55fb46cede2a9f9afe99a54c28e4cbfe6db046a91845f73617bff647076a1ba', 'sqltest_support.py': '88fadd8d1496e988eb8fa9f4751287b4d4a4a534e3d637ee7c60a80cb1811e8f'}
+
+
+def error(reason, **details):
+    print('CHECK_RESULT=' + json.dumps({
+        'instance_id': INSTANCE_ID, 'status': 'BLOCKED' if TEST_STATUS == 'dependency_placeholder' else 'ERROR',
+        'harness_error': reason, 'required_check_ids': REQUIRED_CHECK_IDS,
+        'checks': [], 'reproduced': False, **details,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+    return 2
+
+
+def main():
+    folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    for name, digest in EXPECTED_FILES.items():
+        path = folder / name
+        if not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
+            return error('CASE_TEST_ASSET_MISMATCH', asset=name)
+    scenario = json.loads((folder / 'scenario.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+    if scenario.get('instance_id') != INSTANCE_ID:
+        return error('SCENARIO_INSTANCE_MISMATCH')
+    if TEST_STATUS == 'dependency_placeholder':
+        return error('DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED', blockers=scenario.get('blockers', []),
+                     dependencies=scenario.get('dependency_requirements', []))
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(folder))
+    runpy.run_path(str(folder / 'case_body.py'), run_name='__main__')
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())
problem_statement:
AV when trying to manage users list using EXECUTE STATEMENT on behalf of non-sysdba user which has RDB$ADMIN role [CORE4766]

Submitted by: @pavel-zotov

Attachments:
[av-when-trying-to-manage-users-list-using-es-on-behalf-of-non-sysdba-user-with-rdbadmin-role.zip](https://github.com/FirebirdSQL/jira-attachments/raw/main/CORE/CORE-4766/12720_av-when-trying-to-manage-users-list-using-es-on-behalf-of-non-sysdba-user-with-rdbadmin-role.zip)

Consider the following script:

    set list on;

    show version;
    select mon$user,mon$remote\_protocol,mon$auth\_method from mon$attachments where mon$attachment\_id=current\_connection;
    commit;

    set echo on;
    drop user boss;
    drop user ozzy;
    commit;
    create user boss password '123' grant admin role;
    commit;
    
    select u\.sec$user\_name, u\.sec$plugin, u\.sec$admin from sec$users u where u\.sec$user\_name='BOSS';

    set term ^;
    execute block as
    begin
        execute statement 'create user ozzy password ''456'''
        as user 'BOSS' password '123' role 'RDB$ADMIN';
    end
    ^
    set term ;^
    commit;

    \-\- EXIT; \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- \[ 1 \]
    
    select u\.sec$user\_name, sec$plugin, u\.sec$admin
    from sec$users u
    where u\.sec$user\_name = upper\('ozzy'\);

    set term ^;
    execute block as
    begin
        execute statement 'drop user ozzy'
        as user 'BOSS' password '123' role 'RDB$ADMIN';
    end
    ^
    set term ;^
    commit;


    drop user boss;
    commit;

CASE\-1\.
#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠
When this script is running untill to commented '\-\- EXIT; \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- \[ 1 \]' statement \(i\.e\. when it is uncommented\) FB will crash and firebird\.log will contain:
===
CSPROG	Tue Apr 21 16:38:17 2015
	Shutting down the server with 2 active connection\(s\) to 1 database\(s\), 0 active service\(s\)


CSPROG	Tue Apr 21 16:38:17 2015
	INET/inet\_error: read errno = 10054


CSPROG	Tue Apr 21 16:38:17 2015
	REMOTE INTERFACE/gds\_\_detach: Unsuccesful detach from database\.
	Uncommitted work may have been lost\.
	Error writing data to the connection\.
===

CASE\-2\.
#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠
When the statement '\-\- EXIT;' will be COMMENTED firebird\.log will contain:
===
CSPROG	Tue Apr 21 16:40:36 2015
	 Access violation\.
		The code attempted to access a virtual
		address without privilege to do so\.
	This exception will cause the Firebird server
	to terminate abnormally\.


CSPROG	Tue Apr 21 16:41:01 2015
	Shutting down the server with 2 active connection\(s\) to 1 database\(s\), 0 active service\(s\)


CSPROG	Tue Apr 21 16:41:02 2015
	INET/inet\_error: read errno = 10054


CSPROG	Tue Apr 21 16:41:02 2015
	REMOTE INTERFACE/gds\_\_detach: Unsuccesful detach from database\.
	Uncommitted work may have been lost\.
	Error writing data to the connection\.
===

\(and I can\`t understand why AV message appear FIRST in this case\)\.

1\) in the folder "1\-logs\-when\-only\-add\-user"  \-\- what occurs for mentioned above case\-1
2\) in the folder "2\-logs\-when\-add\-and\-drop\-user "  \-\- what occurs for mentioned above case\-2

====== Test Details ======

Note\-1\. Name of table in STDERR depends on value of UserManager = \{ Srp \| Legacy\_UserManager \}\.
For 'Srp' it will be 'PLG$SRP\_VIEW', for Legacy\_UserManager \-\- PLG$VIEW\_USERS\.
Because of this, section 'substitution' has been added in order to ignore rest part of line
after words 'TABLE PLG'\.

Note\-2\. User 'boss' is NOT granted with 'RDB$ADMIN' role, only clause "grant admin" present for him
in the creating statement, so all his attempts to create/drop another user will be FAILED\.
Before snapshot 31807 3rd such fail lead FB to crash \(AV\)\.
